_comment: ChatGPT (Developer mode connector) → hosted OmniMind MCP. Steps: ChatGPT → Settings → Connectors → Advanced → enable Developer mode → Create → name OmniMind, URL below. Authentication: choose 'Custom header' / API key if your workspace offers it and paste `Authorization: Bearer omt_…` (token from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools); if the workspace only allows OAuth connectors, header auth is rejected and the hosted server must run in OAuth resource-server mode (OMNIMIND_MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER / _JWKS_URL / _AUDIENCE — docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §6). ChatGPT uses the read-only `search` and `fetch` tools (readOnlyHint: true, no confirmation prompt). The `_local_http_server` block is the LEGACY single-user path: a self-run HTTP server with one static inbound bearer (OMNIMIND_MCP_API_KEY) and the process identity chatgpt-desktop-josh (read-only, sourceWeight 0.6); it only works with clients that can send a header, so for ChatGPT itself use the hosted OAuth path.

hosted_connector.name: OmniMind
hosted_connector.authentication: Custom header `Authorization: Bearer omt_…` where offered; otherwise OAuth (server needs OMNIMIND_MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER)

_health_check: curl -s https://omnimind-mcp-production.up.railway.app/health  (no auth; returns exactly {status, uptime, sessions} — agent/tenant are deliberately not exposed)
